workspace-bound-agent-grant-01.graded_text: Each agent connection is bound to one firm workspace chosen at consent and approved by that firm's Admin, and a consultant who works for several firms makes a separate connection for each.

votes.e: B/project/docs/agent-access.md:16-18 "Each agent connection is **workspace-bound**. When the consultant gives consent, they pick exactly one firm workspace. ... A consultant who works for three firms makes three connections. Each one is a separate authorization of the **same** MCP resource, and each one is approved separately by that firm's Admin."

workspace-bound-agent-grant-02.graded_text: The server checks on every call that the target belongs to the connection's bound workspace and that the consultant's membership and role are still live, so removal from a firm cuts off an existing connection.

votes.e: B/project/docs/agent-access.md:62-70 "On every call, the gate allows the action only when ... the consultant has a live membership in connection.workspaceId AND their role in that workspace grants the capability ... AND connection.status = approved"; :106 "The membership and role come from live data on every call, so removing a member or changing a role affects existing tokens on their next call with no wait for token expiry."; target check :109 "look up the id within the bound workspace. An id from any other firm gives the **same \"not found\" result**".

workspace-bound-agent-grant-03.graded_text: The design offers no connection whose scope spans more than one firm.
